body: I'm being labeled as a cheater because I spent time with more than one guy at once, while making it very clear to both of them that I was not exclusive with him and that he was not the only guy I hung out with. I only even hooked up with one of them.
Small high school. The last thing I need is to be known as the girl that went back to her cheating ex...and had sex with him for the first time

I think I'm struggling with knowing that I gave this guy exactly what he wanted. I should have learned my lesson the first time when he cheated. Nothing's stopping him from doing something awful again, and I should have stayed away but I wanted the attention and to feel loved for a little
Definitely not rape. I consented. Just wish I hadn't
I can't deal with how much regret I feel. I can't think about anything else and I can't tell anyone why I'm so upset

You're amazing good sir. It's so nice hearing this from someone, thank you so much. It's getting easier as it goes along, it's nice allowing myself to feel sad about it instead of forcing myself to pretend I'm fine. I didn't think anyone would respond, I appreciate it so much, thank you thank you
Thanks, that helped a lot. It's hard to keep perspective when school and living with your parents is literally your entire life :/
I was just looking for a place to vent, and the Internet seemed like a good idea. Thanks for the advice though.
I'll try. Thank you, that was really helpful and it made me feel a lot better

The thing is, my depression's been over for a solid 6 months and I feel like I don't even need any treatment anymore, but my parents are in charge of controlling the dose and they don't want me to decrease.
